cases.input: Design a new landing page in a repository with confirmed PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md.
requiredBehaviors: respect PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md as authoritative
route a new surface to frontend-design-shaping
pass personal defaults only as overridable hypotheses
forbiddenBehaviors: replace project rules with personal defaults
skip project context because the requested style seems obvious

cases.input: The user likes a visual direction in one project and asks for another feature elsewhere.
requiredBehaviors: keep a one-off project choice project-scoped
only send repeated or explicitly durable preferences to communication-memory-governance
forbiddenBehaviors: promote a single project choice to global taste
let Impeccable heuristics override confirmed project decisions

cases.input: A design request arrives without confirmed PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md and the agent wants to start coding.
forbiddenBehaviors: infer authoritative product and design context from repository evidence alone
skillAnchors: ersetzt aber niemals das jeweils erforderliche Grilling
